spots.name: Phipps Conservatory and Botanical Gardens

spots.blurbEs: Invernadero victoriano con exposiciones de flores de temporada en Schenley Park

spots.name: Market Square
spots.blurb: Downtown's historic public square ringed by restaurants and cafes
spots.blurbEs: Histórica plaza pública del centro rodeada de restaurantes y cafés

spots.name: Carnegie Museums of Art and Natural History
spots.blurb: Twin museums under one roof: dinosaurs and gems next to a major art collection

spots.name: National Aviary

spots.name: Duquesne Incline
spots.blurb: 1877 cable car up Mount Washington to the city's best skyline view
